gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: LXGW Marker Gothic has wide, generous openings and a faint swell in its strokes, like a plain sans with a pulse. Shantell Sans sits above it. Over pages of text it would feel easygoing.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Loose, hand-drawn and cheerful. Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width throughout, while M PLUS 1 draws big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-2: Shantell Sans has a mouth as wide as a tin can's cut lid, drawn with one fixed nib width. M PLUS 2 follows with a gaping c opening, so the sans-serif text feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-code-lati: Expressive is the word for Shantell Sans, a display face drawn with a fixed nib. And M PLUS Code Latin follows like neon tubing, its sans letters bending at constant thickness.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-rounded-1: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads gently, its terminals stopping short of curling back in, with a sans quietness. Shantell Sans adds ruler-straight, expressive strokes above it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-moderustic: Moderustic traces its curves with a broad nib and leaves them unfinished, a modern sans. And Shantell Sans holds each stroke to one thickness like a drawn cable.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-momo-trust-sans: Momo Trust Sans has bowls as heavy as its stems and curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths. But Shantell Sans, with its fixed nib width, feels livelier right beside it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-mona-sans: Shantell Sans is distinctive, with a mouth as wide as a tin can's cut lid. Its expressive, thick-only outline draws the eye, while Mona Sans keeps its letter openings wide as a door left ajar.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-murecho: Murecho opens its s curves wide at both ends, a modern, clean plain sans. And Shantell Sans adds a fixed-width stencil brush line, so a long read stays lively.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-nanum-gothic: A mouth as wide as a tin can's cut lid is the signature of Shantell Sans. Nanum Gothic gives it wide channels into each counter, a plain sans that feels professional beside the expressive heading.
